rules.statement: A notary public is entitled to perform his functions throughout the area to which he is appointed, even though required to have an office in a particular place for keeping records.
rules.supporting_quote: "He [the learned District Judge] has come to the conclusion that the expression means putting up a notice board, keeping all books and documents, normally carrying on duties, and being present on days and hours as prescribed by the rules, and he points out that there is no evidence that the accused has not done so."
